tasks.title: Create the cmd/agentkit-tools module and serve the directory's tool set with its listing
steps: Create the nested module github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go/cmd/agentkit-tools in cmd/agentkit-tools: a go.mod requiring the root, codesearch and mcpserve modules with replace directives to ../.., ../../codesearch and ../../mcpserve, and a module comment saying it is separate so the root module's graph does not grow; add cmd/agentkit-tools to MODULES and to the module loop of the doc target in the Makefile

Add cmd/agentkit-tools/helpers_test.go: build the binary once for the package's tests into a temporary directory, and a run helper that starts it with arguments, an environment and a working directory and returns stdout, stderr and the exit code; use testutil.Tree and testutil.Environ

Parse `agentkit-tools <mcp|call|tools> [flags]`, with --dir on every subcommand and --version on its own; no subcommand, an unknown one or a flag the subcommand does not take prints usage naming mcp, call and tools to stderr and exits 2. mcp and call may answer 'not yet implemented' with exit 2 until their tasks

Resolve --dir (default the working directory) and refuse a path that does not exist or is not a directory with one stderr line naming it and exit 2, before anything is built; workspace.Open does not do this check

Build the tool set in one function the three subcommands share: workspace.Open, then the code_search index from an index constructor held in a package variable (codesearch.New by default, so a test can make it return codesearch.ErrUnsupported), tools.For with that index and a nil Env (tools.ReducedEnv of the process environment), then codemode.New over all of them, and agentkit.NewRunner with guard.AllowAll
On codesearch.ErrUnsupported, build without the index and write one stderr line saying code_search is not served on this platform
Close the index when the command ends, so its temporary directory is removed

Implement `tools`: one JSON array of {name, description, input_schema, output_schema} in serving order from the runner's Tools(); input_schema is the marshalled schema or {"type":"object"}, output_schema the marshalled schema or null

Implement --version from the binary's build information: the version of the cmd/agentkit-tools module when it is the main module or a dependency (the replacement's when replaced), else (devel), with the algorithm of mcpserve's versionFrom
Write the behaviours of REQ-1 and REQ-5 into cmd/agentkit-tools/toolset_test.go and cmd/agentkit-tools/list_test.go and make them pass

tasks.title: Choose the guard and the served tools from the command line
steps: Add --guard to every subcommand: allow-all (the default) gives the runner guard.AllowAll, restricted gives it guard.Restricted(guard.Options{}); any other value exits 2 with one stderr line naming allow-all and restricted

Add --tools (a comma-separated list, spaces around names trimmed) and --read-only to every subcommand; --read-only leaves out write_file, edit_file, execute and run_command; with both, a tool is served when both allow it; the served order is always the serving order

Apply the selection to the tools of tools.For and code_search before code mode is built, then build code_mode over exactly the selected tools, and serve it only when --tools is absent or names it and at least one other tool is selected
A --tools name that is no tool exits 2 with one stderr line quoting it and listing every tool name; a selection that leaves no tool exits 2 with one stderr line saying no tool is selected
Write the behaviours of REQ-2 into cmd/agentkit-tools/toolset_test.go as tables and make them pass

tasks.title: Make one tool call from a request file
steps: Add `call` with --request (required) and --timeout (default 10m); a --timeout that does not parse or is not positive exits 2 with one stderr line

Read the request file, refusing more than 16 MiB without reading past it; a missing, unreadable or oversized file, content that is not a JSON object, or a name that is absent, not a string or empty exits 2 with nothing on stdout and one stderr line
Pass an absent input as {} and any present input verbatim to Runner.Call, so a non-object input is the runner's invalid_arguments result and a name the selection left out is its unknown_tool result

Write the result as one JSON object: core.ToolResult's own marshalling (ok, data, error, detail, metadata) plus text, the result's LLMText followed by the text of each core.TextBlock in Blocks, joined with a newline; exit 0 whenever a result is written

Run the call under a context with the --timeout deadline; when the deadline passes, cancel it and write {ok: false, error: timeout, detail naming the duration} as soon as the call returns or 5 seconds after the deadline, whichever comes first
On SIGINT or SIGTERM cancel the call, write nothing to stdout and exit 130 or 143

Write the behaviours of REQ-4 into cmd/agentkit-tools/call_test.go, with the relay flow of PATH-2 and the code_mode script of PATH-3 as tests there, and the call rows of REQ-3.4's signal table into cmd/agentkit-tools/mcp_test.go; make them pass

tasks.title: Serve one MCP session on stdin and stdout
steps: Add `mcp`: build the runner as the other subcommands do, then mcpserve.New with Name agentkit-tools, Version the command's version and a Logger writing to stderr, and ServeStdio under a context that SIGINT and SIGTERM cancel
Keep the index open for the whole session and close it after ServeStdio returns

Exit 0 when ServeStdio returns nil; exit 130 or 143 when a signal ended it; for any other error write one line, `agentkit-tools: mcp session ended: frame rejected: <rule>` when errors.As finds a wire.Error, else `agentkit-tools: mcp session ended: session error`, never the error's own text, and exit 1
Write nothing to stdout outside ServeStdio

Write into cmd/agentkit-tools/mcp_test.go the session of PATH-1 through the MCP Go SDK client over mcp.CommandTransport, the rejected-frame test of REQ-3.3 mirroring mcpserve's TestAFrameThatBreaksTheWireLimitsEndsTheSessionUnserved, and the mcp rows of REQ-3.4's signal table; make them pass

tasks.title: Add the examples/toolserver example that drives the command in both modes
steps: Create examples/toolserver as its own module requiring cmd/agentkit-tools, the root module and the MCP Go SDK, with replace directives to the local modules; add it to MODULES
The program writes a small sample project to a temporary directory, builds agentkit-tools from its module into a temporary directory with the go toolchain, and removes both when it ends

It prints the tool names from `agentkit-tools tools`, then starts `agentkit-tools mcp --dir <sample>` through the MCP Go SDK client over mcp.CommandTransport and prints a code_search hit and an edit found by a second search, then runs `agentkit-tools call` with a request file for code_search and for a code_mode script and prints the results, then a completion line
Where code_search is not served on the platform, it says so and runs the rest; it needs no API key and no network beyond the module cache

Write examples/toolserver/README.md (what it shows, how to run it, what it prints), and examples/toolserver/main_test.go running the program with testutil.GoRun as examples/indexedsearch/main_test.go does; make it pass

Bring each touched document's Contents index in step with its headings
